caption: The drawing depicts a textile design composed of various geometric and natural motifs in a rectangular format. The textile includes horizontal bands of green, red, brown, blue, and white colors with woven designs. In the upper section, there is a large bird, possibly a swan or goose, in white with green and blue foliage around it. Below, there are floral patterns in brown and white, and more green foliage above a red band with white star-like crosses. Objects resembling chalices or goblets are present in red on a white background on the right side. The bottom left section contains the text "PETER LORENZ 1841" in white letters on a blue background, and there are star and floral motifs in white around the text. The textile appears to have a frayed edge on the left and bottom sides, and the artwork is mounted on a neutral beige background.
title: Coverlet
